name: CUDA-OpenGL Buffer Interoperability
definition: A lifecycle management technique for Buffer Objects (BOs) shared between OpenGL and CUDA. After allocation in OpenGL, the buffer is registered with CUDA. It alternates accessibility for integration (CUDA) or rendering (OpenGL).
summary: CUDA-OpenGL Buffer Interoperability enables zero-copy data exchange between CUDA kernels and OpenGL by mapping Buffer Objects directly into CUDA memory, distinct from general interoperability by focusing specifically on vertex and fragment data lifecycle management.
